import requests

for acc in ['Q8TDF5-1', 'Q8TDF5-2', 'Q8TDF5-3', 'Q9UGP5-1', 'Q9UGP5-2']:
    r = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta")
    lines = r.text.strip().split('\n')
    header = lines[0]
    seq = "".join(lines[1:])
    # calculate rough molecular weight
    from Bio.SeqUtils.ProtParam import ProteinAnalysis
    X = ProteinAnalysis(seq)
    mw = X.molecular_weight()
    print(f"{acc}: length = {len(seq)}, MW = {mw:.2f} Da ({mw/1000:.2f} kDa)")
